title: Shijing (Classic of Poetry)
summary: The Shijing, or Classic of Poetry, is a Chinese anthology of poems collected from central China and the lower Yellow River valley, dating from the Zhou dynasty into the Spring and Autumn period. It holds 305 poems with text, and Columbia University Press describes it as the oldest existing collection of poetry in China.
